source: Azure Monitor metric ModelRequests on the classic Azure OpenAI resource, 1-minute buckets, 21:05 to 21:45 UTC on 2026-11-17, split by deployment and status code. Queried afterwards with az monitor metrics list.
resource: a classic Azure OpenAI resource (kind OpenAI), name not published

rows.attribution: direct requests polling the rate-limit headers (not Cursor)
test K plus the last direct header poll
test M1: the old deployment, because the on-screen change was not saved
test N plus one direct check of the new deployment

not_visible: M2 (deployment that did not exist) and O (empty Base URL) left no rows, as expected: Azure does not record requests for unknown deployments, and O never reached Azure.
